name: Khaos Control Essential Connector for WooCommerce®
author: Khaos Control

sections.description:
Integrate Khaos Control Essential to your WooCommerce® store and start adding automation to your operation across single and multichannel marketplaces.

This plugin will help connect WooCommerce® and Khaos Control Essential together with ease, proving helpful debugging information and a step-by-step process that does all the heavy lifting!

What is Khaos Control Essential?
Khaos Control Essential is an online business management solution that helps manage all your operations in one place. All you need is a web browser and access to the internet!

Our solution streamlines everything you need to run a successful business, such as: order processing, inventory management, eCommerce store synchronisation, courier assignment, financial reporting, customer accounts, promotions and so much more.

Take advantage of automating manual processes that hold you back; save time, reduce your business running costs and prevent the chance of human error.

Find out more: www.khaoscloud.com
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial plugin release

1.1

  • Rebranding Khaos Control Cloud to Khaos Control Essential
  • Changed base language to English (United Kingdom) and added translation for English (United States)
  • Removed option for automated connection as this is no longer available
